product.name: TrustAgent
product.tagline: Catch hallucinations before your users do.
product.subhead: An open-source gateway that checks every LLM answer against the documents your app already sent — in {claim:fast_check_latency_approx}, for {claim:fast_check_cost_per_1k} [estimate] — and sends only the risky ones to a full LLM audit.

demo.title: Demo stack
demo.body: Mock checks and a mock judge: every number here is simulated.

readonly.title: Read-only instance
readonly.body: You can explore traces and settings, but nothing can be changed here.

budget_exhausted.title: Today's fast-check budget is used up
budget_exhausted.body: Observe and flag routes skip the fast check for the rest of the day; enforcing routes follow their fail mode.
budget_exhausted.action: Raise the daily cap in Settings → Budgets.

unauthorized.title: The fast-check key was rejected
unauthorized.body: OpenRouter refused the key, so answers pass unchecked.

no_credits.title: Your OpenRouter account has no credits
no_credits.body: Key works but your OpenRouter account has no credits — add about $5 at openrouter.ai/settings/credits

breaker_open.title: Fast check paused after repeated errors
breaker_open.body: Route {route} enforces decisions; until the fast check recovers it follows its fail mode ({fail}).
breaker_open.action: See Settings → Models for the last error.

llm_exhausted.title: Deep audits paused: today's deep-audit budget is used up
llm_exhausted.body: Fast checks keep running. Deep audits start again tomorrow, or as soon as the budget is raised.
llm_exhausted.action: Raise the deep-audit budget in Settings → Budgets.

states.empty_traffic: No requests yet. Send one with the curl snippet or try the Playground.

disabled_reasons.readonly: Not available on a read-only instance
disabled_reasons.demo: Not available on the demo stack

step_secure.title: Secure this dashboard
step_secure.no_token: Find the setup token in the proxy logs, or print a fresh setup URL:
step_secure.save_admin_key: Copy your admin key now. It is shown only once.

step_connect.title: Connect OpenRouter
step_connect.simulated: Try it without a key (simulated checks, $0)
step_connect.privacy: Prompts, answers and documents are sent to OpenRouter/TypeSafe for checking; routes can opt out.
step_connect.no_credits: Key works but your OpenRouter account has no credits — add about $5 at openrouter.ai/settings/credits
step_connect.prerequisite: You need an OpenRouter account with about $5 of credit (≈1,600 answers at default settings, estimate).
step_connect.simulated_note: Simulated checks use a mock model: results are labelled Simulated and never block an answer.
step_connect.simulated_on: Simulated checks are on. Connect a key any time to check answers for real.
step_connect.no_limit: This key has no spending limit. Set one at openrouter.ai/settings/keys so a mistake can't run up costs.
step_connect.judge_env_managed: The deep-audit judge is set by the environment, so it was left as it is.
step_connect.callback_origin_mismatch: This sign-in started at a different address. Open the dashboard at {public_url} and connect again.
step_connect.callback_expired: This sign-in link has expired or was already used. Start Connect OpenRouter again.
step_connect.callback_missing: No sign-in is waiting in this tab. Open the dashboard at {public_url} and connect again.
step_connect.exchange_failed: OpenRouter didn't accept this sign-in. Start Connect OpenRouter again.

step_see_it_work.title: See it work
step_see_it_work.body: Try a refund question whose answer says 60 days while the policy says 30. No upstream key needed.

step_try.title: See it work
step_try.disabled_reason: Connect a key or turn on simulated checks first.
step_try.ingest_key: Copy this app key now. Your app sends it as X-TrustAgent-Key. It is shown only once.

connect_app.title: Connect your app
connect_app.demo_stack: This is the demo stack: mock checks, $0. To use your own keys: {command:demo_to_own_keys}.

consent: Your OpenRouter key stays in this browser tab and is sent only to openrouter.ai.
Checks are billed to your OpenRouter account; your account needs credits.
Forget the key here at any time, or revoke it at openrouter.ai/settings/keys.
playground_static.cap_reached: This demo stops after {max_calls} calls. Run it yourself for more.

trace.answer_not_sent: Your model's answer (not sent to the user)
trace.received_fallback: A fallback answer written from your documents only, then checked again: {result}.
trace.received_fallback_no_documents: A fallback answer written without documents (this request carried none), then checked again: {result}.
trace.received_blocked: The route's block message, sent in place of your model's answer.
trace.received_not_stored: The text sent instead is not stored for this request.
trace.see_received: See what the user received instead
trace.timing_description: From the request reaching the proxy to the answer leaving it. The deep audit runs afterwards.
trace.headers_description: What your app received, rebuilt from the stored decision the way the gateway sends it.
trace.headers_action_only: This route sends only the action (headers: action_only).
trace.headers_setting_unknown: Shown with every header: this request's policy version could not be read to check the route's headers setting.
trace.headers_stream: A streamed answer carries the decision headers as trailers and a stream comment when the route passes streams straight through.
trace.headers_late: The fast check answered after the answer was sent, so these are the headers of the check that timed out, as the trace recorded them.
trace.late_note: The fast check answered after the deadline, so its result did not change what was sent.

flags.multi_choice: Several answers in one response: only the first was checked
flags.client_disconnected: The client disconnected before the answer finished
flags.late_decision: The fast check answered late: recorded, not enforced
flags.text_redacted: Text redacted before it was stored

trace.disagreement: Fast check passed it; deep audit found {count} contradicted claim(s).
trace.recompile_match: Matches a recompile of this request
trace.recompile_mismatch: Differs from a recompile of this request

overview.audited_share_basis: among audited answers (selected by risk; not a traffic rate)

savings.headline: Your cost: {total_per_1k} per 1,000 answers (fast check {fast_check} + deep audit {deep_audit})
savings.early_data: So far: {n} answers checked for {cost}. Asking an LLM the same questions would have cost ≈ {counterfactual} (estimate).
savings.caption: The fast check triages; deep audits add claim-level explanations.
savings.calculator_footnote: The fast check triages; it doesn't replace claim-level audit.

policies.diverged_file: policies.yaml changed at {file_time} and replaced your dashboard edit from {edit_time}

downgrades.stream_not_buffered: Streams pass straight through, so this route can only flag. Buffer streams to block.
downgrades.uncalibrated: Blocking stays off until every blocking check is calibrated for the current snapshot.
downgrades.snapshot_changed: The fast-check version changed; blocking pauses until its checks are re-calibrated.
downgrades.budget: Today's fast-check budget is used up.
downgrades.breaker_open: The fast check is paused after repeated errors.
downgrades.decision_model_off: The fast check is turned off.
downgrades.trusts_user_context: This route treats text pasted by users as documents; a user could make a false answer look supported.

evaluators.reliability_caption: agreement with labels, not ground truth
evaluators.benchmarks_empty: No measured benchmark runs yet. Run {command:bench_lite} to create one.

calibration_import_rejected.unknown_version: Skipped: this gateway has no such evaluator version. Create or import that version first.
calibration_import_rejected.calibration_key_mismatch: Skipped: it was fitted on a different question than this evaluator version asks. Calibrate it again from labels.
calibration_import_rejected.mock_snapshot: Skipped: calibrations of the simulated decision model apply only to the zero-key demo and the test stacks.
calibration_import_rejected.invalid: Skipped: this entry doesn't validate, or the file calibrates the same check twice.

studio.dry_run_cancelled: Test stopped. You're charged only for the checks that already ran ({cost}).
studio.static_soon: Coming soon to the online demo. Run TrustAgent yourself to use Studio: {command:demo}
studio.draft_simulated: Drafted by the mock model (simulated). Connect a judge for a real draft.

lint.unresolved_state_reference: Refers to a field the check doesn't read
lint.unknown_risk_weight_option: Risk weight for an option that doesn't exist
lint.risk_level_out_of_range: Risk level past the last answer level
lint.unknown_evaluator_reference: Refers to an evaluator that doesn't exist
lint.unknown_detector: Refers to an instant check that doesn't exist
lint.reference_not_attached: Refers to an evaluator this route doesn't run
lint.missing_escape_option: No option for answers with nothing to judge
lint.non_descriptive_key: An option's name doesn't say what it means
lint.counting_or_arithmetic: Asks the model to count or do arithmetic
lint.near_duplicate_options: Two options read almost the same
lint.numeric_only_score_levels: Score levels described only by a number
lint.score_used_for_policy: A score question used for a policy decision

recording.mock: Simulated (mock checks + mock judge): not model output

limits: Jev launched on 2026-09-15 on an alpha endpoint with no published calibration, so thresholds are calibrated locally per version.
Weak on numbers, dates and negation; instant checks and the deep audit cover them.
Needs documents for groundedness; otherwise the answer is marked not checked.

settings.env_managed: Set in .env ({keys}); change it there and restart.
settings.engine_env_managed: Set in the engine's .env. Check it with {command:doctor}.
settings.credential_undecryptable: This saved key can't be read with the current master key. Paste it again, or restore the old TRUTHTABLE_SECRET_KEY.
settings.store_unavailable: Keys can't be saved here yet. Set TRUTHTABLE_SECRET_KEY (or let TrustAgent generate one) and restart.
settings.no_database: Keys can't be saved without a database. Keys set in .env still work.
settings.master_key_changed: The master key changed, so {names} can't be read. Paste those keys again, or restore the previous TRUTHTABLE_SECRET_KEY.
settings.fail_closed_confirm: These routes fail closed and would block every answer without a fast check: {routes}. Continue anyway?
settings.last_admin_key: This is the last admin key. Create another admin key first, or you'll lose access to Settings.
settings.current_session_key: You're signed in with this key. Revoking it signs you out.
settings.reenter_secret: The address changed, so paste the {names} key again to send it there.
settings.secret_once: Copy this key now. It is shown only once.
settings.sign_out_everywhere_confirm: Every dashboard session, including this one, will need to sign in again.
settings.stale_version: Settings changed in another tab. Reload to see the latest, then try again.
settings.prices_override_note: Your prices override the built-in table for cost estimates only; providers bill what they bill.
settings.price_zero_not_local: $0 is only allowed for local models. {provider} bills its calls.
settings.price_duplicate_override: Price {n} already covers this model, so this one would never apply.
settings.price_far_above_contracts: This is {ratio}× the built-in price of ${contracts_per_mtok} per million tokens. Check the units: USD per million tokens.
settings.unknown_setting: This isn't a setting that can be changed here.
settings.invalid_type: This value has the wrong type for this setting.
settings.binding_mismatch: The default upstream's key and its binding must name the same key. Set one of them, or set both to the same key.
settings.unknown_credential: There is no key with this name.
settings.credential_kind: The {names} key can't be used for this.
settings.credential_missing: No {names} key is saved. Add it under Connections first.
settings.backend_pinned: The fast-check backend is set in .env (TRUTHTABLE_JEV_BACKEND) and doesn't use the {names} key. Change it there and restart.
settings.origin_not_allowed: The {names} key can't be sent to this address.
settings.fallback_key_required: The fallback upstream at {host} is on another host, so it needs its own key. Save an upstream-fallback key first.
settings.invalid_url: Enter a full address that starts with https://.
settings.url_credentials: Take the user name and password out of the address. Save the key under Connections instead.
settings.insecure_url: Use an https:// address. Plain http:// is allowed only for localhost and single-word service names such as ollama.
settings.forbidden_target: This address points at a link-local or cloud-metadata target, which never receives a key.

verify_hint.not_checked: Not checked: nothing was sent to the provider. Upstream keys are saved without a check.
verify_hint.probe_skipped: OpenRouter accepted the key, but TrustAgent's own budget or rate limit held the test request back, so the credits aren't confirmed yet. Check again later.
verify_hint.not_found: The provider doesn't serve the configured model. Check the model in Settings → Models.
verify_hint.bad_request: The provider refused the test request. Check the model and the address in Settings → Models.
verify_hint.data_policy: Your OpenRouter privacy settings rule out every provider for this model. Allow one at openrouter.ai/settings/privacy, or unset TRUTHTABLE_JEV_ZDR.
verify_hint.too_large: The test request was too large for this model.
verify_hint.timeout: The provider didn't answer in time. Try again in a minute.
verify_hint.retryable: The provider couldn't be reached or had a temporary error. Try again in a minute.
verify_hint.rate_limited: TrustAgent's own rate limit held the test request back. Try again in a minute.
verify_hint.overload: TrustAgent is busy with other checks, so the test request wasn't sent. Try again in a minute.
verify_hint.budget: Today's fast-check budget is used up, so the test request wasn't sent. Raise it in Settings → Budgets.
verify_hint.breaker_open: The fast check is paused after repeated errors, so the test request wasn't sent. Try again in a minute.
verify_hint.off: The fast check is off, so the key wasn't tested.
verify_hint.credentials_unavailable: This key may not be sent to the provider's address, so nothing was sent.
verify_hint.bad_content_type: The address answered with a web page instead of the API. Check the address in Settings → Models.
verify_hint.bad_response: The provider's answer couldn't be read. Try again, or check the model in Settings → Models.

labels.title: Label queue
labels.intro: Was each flag right? Your answers calibrate the check so it can block safely.
labels.empty: Nothing to label right now. New answers near the flag line show up here.
labels.keys_hint: C correct · F false alarm · S skip
labels.saved: Saved. Thanks — {n} more and this check can be calibrated.
labels.body_expired: This answer's text has expired, so it can't be labelled.

badges.simulated_checks_hint: The fast check uses a mock model: results are labelled Simulated and never block.
